motions.item_title: Approve the June 16, 2020 minutes. Board Member Gray seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Jar…
motions.motion: Board Member Burnham moved to approve the June 16, 2020 minutes. Board Member Gray seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Jared Gray, Carolyn Love, Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, and Donna Burnham. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: June 2020 minutes approved
motions.summary: The agency board approved the written record of its June 16, 2020 meeting.
motions.impact: Signing off on old minutes is bookkeeping for the recorder's office. Nothing in it touches you.

motions.item_title: Appoint Tom Westmoreland to serve as Chair of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City.…
motions.motion: Board Member Gray moved to appoint Tom Westmoreland to serve as Chair of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City. Board Member Burnham seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Jared Gray, Carolyn Love, Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, and Donna Burnham. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Mayor Westmoreland named agency chair
motions.summary: The board named Tom Westmoreland chair of the redevelopment agency, the seat the mayor holds by default under agency bylaws adopted in 2008.
motions.impact: Chairing the agency lets the mayor speak for the city on economic development. Residents feel none of it.

motions.item_title: Appoint Carolyn Love to serve as Vice-Chair of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City.…
motions.motion: Board Member Curtis moved to appoint Carolyn Love to serve as Vice-Chair of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City. Board Member Burnham seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Jared Gray, Carolyn Love, Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, and Donna Burnham- The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Carolyn Love named vice-chair
motions.summary: The agency board appointed Board Member Carolyn Love as vice-chair of the redevelopment agency for the year.
motions.impact: A vice-chair runs the meeting when the chair cannot. The choice stays inside the board and reaches no household.

motions.item_title: Approve u resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, adopting an Offi…
motions.motion: Board Member Burnham moved to approve u resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, adopting an Official Project Area Plan for the Sweetwater Industrial Park Community Reinvestment Area #2. Board Member Gray seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Jared Gray, Carolyn Love, Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, and Donna Burnham The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Plan adopted for Sweetwater data center area
motions.summary: The agency adopted the project area plan for Sweetwater Industrial Park reinvestment area #2, the framework for an agreement to bring a data center to the city.
motions.impact: Consultants told the board the project will not raise property taxes on other properties. The development agreement still has to go to the City Council, so the deal itself is not settled yet.

motions.item_title: Approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, adopting an Offi…
motions.motion: Board Member Burnham moved to approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, adopting an Official Project Area Budget for the Sweetwater Industrial Park Community Reinvestment Area #2, using the amended 67.5% real property tax value. Board Member Gray seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Jared Gray, Carolyn Love, Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, and Donna Burnham. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Sweetwater industrial park budget set at 67.5%
motions.summary: The agency adopted the budget for the Sweetwater Industrial Park reinvestment area #2, counting 67.5% of the site's real property tax value instead of the 75% first proposed.
motions.impact: Nobody's tax bill moves because of this. The percentage sets how much of the site's future property tax growth the agency puts back into the project rather than passing on to the county, schools, fire and water districts.

motions.item_title: Adjourn the meeting at 7:38 p.m. Board Member Love seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Jared…
motions.motion: Board Member Gray moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:38 p.m. Board Member Love seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Jared Gray, Carolyn Love, Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, and Donna Burnham. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Meeting adjourned
motions.summary: The agency board ended its March 16 meeting at 7:38 p.m.
motions.impact: Closing the meeting is the last item on any agenda. There is nothing here for you.
